title: Implement reportFanoutCandidate preflight visibility
instructions:
Implement only S1 for references/initiatives/structured-agent-fanout-autopilot.md: closed-schema reportFanoutCandidate validation and report-only visibility. Add the minimal types and validator support to src/core/sequential-ceo-autopilot.ts, wire continuation:show in src/cli.ts to include a reportFanoutCandidate/preflight report when present, and add focused tests in tests/sequential-ceo-autopilot.test.ts plus CLI coverage if existing continuation:show tests require it.

Required candidate boundary: reportFanoutCandidate is optional and may be absent or null. When present, it must be a single closed object. It is not an execution trigger. It must support only report/spec/reviewer/evaluator advice fanout planning and must preserve false side effects. Use a small explicit schema, for example requestedRoles, sourceArtifacts, expectedReportPaths, synthesisRequired, executionMode, and expectedSideEffects. Keep names consistent and deterministic.

Validation/report requirements: validate the current continuation artifact before inspecting reportFanoutCandidate. Reject malformed or open-schema candidates, unknown roles, empty role/source/report lists, prose paths, command strings, URLs, absolute paths, traversal, environment expansion, globs, missing source artifacts, off-repo source artifacts, executionMode values other than report_only/preflight_only as appropriate, synthesisRequired values other than true, and any side-effect request for worker dispatch, worktree creation, run log creation, lifecycle mutation, merge, cleanup, commit, push, run_task, batches:execute, successor execution, daemon/watch, remote adapter, dashboard, connector expansion, hidden memory, or worker-owned orchestration. Accepted reports must be advice-only: trustedStateChanges false, pushPerformed false, side effects false, no worker dispatch, no worktrees, no runs, no lifecycle changes.

Do not implement reportFanoutExecution, actual report fanout dispatch, synthesis/status evidence, batchPlanCandidate, batchPlanExecution, batch execution, worker-owned orchestration, writerCap changes, push automation, daemon/watch behavior, dashboards, remote adapters, connector expansion, hidden memory, or natural-language-only dispatch. Do not modify task specs or operation artifacts from the worker. Update references/initiatives/structured-agent-fanout-autopilot.md only to mark S1 completed and S2 ready/proposed with implementation evidence language; do not add new roadmap scope. Run all verify commands. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
